edges.text: 180 credits from a programme in biochemistry/chemistry, biology, biomedicine/medicine, biotechnology, cell/molecular biology, genetics, life science, medical sciences or a similar field of study. Also required are courses in biochemistry, cell biology, chemistry, genetics, and molecular biology/genetics totalling at least 30 credits. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

result.labelEn: Students may either start the 45 hp Master's Project in Precision Medicine (3MG056) or take elective courses totalling 15 hp.
